offers_products.reason: Sells an ad-tech software platform (Realize) with AI-driven recommendation and advertising tools to advertisers and publishers.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from the platform's ad placements and tools, not from staff-delivered work for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Buyers are advertisers and publishers; readers see content and ads but do not buy from Taboola.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Advertisers such as Hyundai, Bosch and eToro, plus publishers and mobile carriers, buy the platform.

recurring_revenue.reason: Advertisers and publishers keep running campaigns and placements on an ongoing basis, with repeat spend.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising budgets are among the first things businesses cut in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Campaign spend is small and frequent, billed per click or action, not a large one-off purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the AI platform, data and publisher network, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Case studies feature large brands like Mercedes-Benz, Hyundai, Bosch and AIG, plus large publishers.

asset_heavy.reason: Software and ad-tech platform; growth needs engineering and data capacity, not plants, fleets or properties.
